project.title: Escherichia coli strain:HBT14 Genome sequencing
project.description: Escherichia coli HBT14 is an exoelectrogenic Gram-negative bacterium isolated from municipal wastewater. A dual-chambered MFC containing an anode chamber and a cathode chamber, with both chambers connected by a proton exchange membrane was constructed to detect the presence of exoelectrogenic bacteria in the municipal wastewater sample collected from Islamic University Bangladesh. A loopful of anode biofilm from a fully functioning MFC was scratched and introduced on the Mno2 supplemented exoelectrogen growth and isolation medium with some modifications for the isolation of Escherichia coli HBT14.
project.center_name: Laboratory of Medical and Environmental Biotechnology

runs: Whole genome sequencing of Escherichia coli HBT14
